title: WaterColor 113 Pond Cypress Way
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: *Per Watercolor HOA, please include all guests aged 5 and older in your total count of adult guests to receive amenity and pool access wristbands. Sleep arrangements are provided as a courtesy and are not considered in the occupancy count.**This home is allowed 10 amenity access bands.**- Located on quiet cul-de-sac in Watercolor's Camp District- Natural gas grill- Covered carport for 2 vehicles- 3 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAIL: 113 Pond Cypress Way, a 3-bedroom, 4-bathroom home, is located on a tranquil cul-de-sac in Watercolor's Lake District. This open concept home offers multiple covered porches off the first floor, and a wrap-around screened porch off the second with a cozy view of the neighborhood conservation area. On the first floor, you'll find a primary suite, 2 guest bedrooms, a queen sleeper sofa, and a twin bunk in the hall. The second floor offers an open floor plan with a living area, dining area, and a fully-equipped gourmet kitchen. Its large vaulted ceilings allow for plenty of sunlight to pour into the room! 113 Pond Cypress Way is 150 yards from the desirable Camp Watercolor, with pool, playground, and park within easy reach.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: FIRST FLOOR: - Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: Two Twin over Twin Bunk bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Hallway: Twin Bunk Beds- Living Room: Queen Sleeper SofaWeddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.Please note: Per HOA Policy, all Low-Speed Vehicle rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 80 vehicles throughout the community at any given time. Homes are permitted one Low-Speed Vehicle per home. Homes with owner provided Low-Speed Vehicles are not permitted to rent an additional Low-Speed Vehicle.
